name: lumi-api-test-h5
description: Lumi API 黑盒测试：Postman 集合（开发调试）+ Newman（CI 自动化）+ Vitest（代码单元测试）

scripts.newman:s5:smoke: newman run postman/lumi-s5-content-media.postman_collection.json -e postman/lumi-device-platform.postman_environment.json --folder "00 · 健康检查" --folder "10 · 场景A · 端到端最小验收" --folder "12 · 场景C · 鉴权与参数负向" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/s5-smoke-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).html
scripts.newman:s5:device: newman run postman/lumi-s5-content-media.postman_collection.json -e postman/lumi-device-platform.postman_environment.json --folder "01 · 设备 API · CMS Catalog PlayResource Categories Library Recommendations" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/s5-device-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).html
scripts.newman:s5:guardian: newman run postman/lumi-s5-content-media.postman_collection.json -e postman/lumi-device-platform.postman_environment.json --folder "03 · 家长 API · CMS Catalog Categories Library Recommendations PublicationCommand Uploads" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/s5-guardian-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).html
scripts.newman:s5:ops: newman run postman/lumi-s5-content-media.postman_collection.json -e postman/lumi-device-platform.postman_environment.json --folder "02 · 运营 API · Categories Uploads Publications" --folder "04 · 运营 API · CMS Pages" --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/s5-ops-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).html
scripts.newman:all: npm run newman:device-platform && npm run newman:s4 && npm run newman:s5
